assets.applicability: Natural-language guidance where grammar or style signals may reduce, but not replace, editorial judgment.
assets.contribution: LanguageTool may contribute existing grammar and style signals after later evidence identifies applicable rules.
assets.evidence_basis: This catalogs a capability family only; it does not assert that a specific rule satisfies an opportunity.
limitations: A later evidence stage must establish rule availability for the selected language and version.
No individual warning proves that text is concise, readable, or editorially correct.
assets.name: LanguageTool existing capability families

assets.applicability: Prose requirements with measurable length, sentence, or lexical indicators.
assets.contribution: Deterministic metrics can measure properties such as word count and sentence length as partial signals.
assets.evidence_basis: The measurements are deterministic; useful thresholds remain project-specific and require evidence.
limitations: Metrics are proxies and do not establish clarity, usefulness, or concision by themselves.
Thresholds can incentivize unhelpfully terse output.
assets.name: Text metrics

assets.applicability: Projects with language variants, category choices, severity policy, or rule enablement requirements.
assets.contribution: LanguageTool categories, language variants, enablement, and severity mapping may be configured after evidence identifies useful settings.
assets.evidence_basis: Configuration is a possible deterministic asset path, not evidence that a useful project configuration already exists.
limitations: Configuration only exposes behavior supported by the chosen LanguageTool version.
Editorial policies may remain subjective even after configuration.
assets.name: LanguageTool project configuration

assets.applicability: Terminology, prohibited wording, and organization-specific writing conventions that can be expressed as rules.
assets.contribution: A project may extend LanguageTool with custom rules when evidence shows built-in rules and configuration are insufficient.
assets.evidence_basis: This records an extension point only; it does not imply that a custom rule exists, is verified, or has been adopted.
limitations: Custom-rule feasibility and false-positive behavior require later verification.
Rules cannot fully replace judgment about audience, nuance, or overall concision.
assets.name: Custom LanguageTool rules
